uppsala-university.brief: Uppsala University is a public research university in Uppsala, Sweden. It was founded in 1477 and is the first university in the Nordic countries. It offers international Bachelor's and Master's programmes in Uppsala and Visby. The university works with Uppsala University Hospital, Region Uppsala, and Blue Centre Gotland. Its Uppsala Science Park is home to over 140 companies.

wageningen-university-research.name: Wageningen University & Research
wageningen-university-research.brief: Wageningen University & Research is a public technical research university and a non-profit research institute in Wageningen, Netherlands. It specialises in life sciences, with a focus on agriculture, technical and engineering subjects. The university offers 21 BSc programmes and 32 MSc programmes. It is organised into 1 Faculty with 5 departments and 88 chair groups. Its campus is Wageningen Campus, with locations in Wageningen and other places in The Netherlands.

ecole-normale-superieure-de-lyon.name: École Normale Supérieure de Lyon
ecole-normale-superieure-de-lyon.brief: École normale supérieure de Lyon is a French grande école located in the city of Lyon. It is one of the four écoles normales supérieures in France. The university offers training and research in arts and humanities as well as in STEM subjects. Its teaching is organised in 12 departments, supported by research units. The campus is located close to the city center.

arizona-state-university.name: Arizona State University
arizona-state-university.brief: Arizona State University is a public research university in Tempe, Arizona, United States. Founded in 1885 as Territorial Normal School, it is one of the largest public universities by enrollment in the United States. It offers more than 450 undergraduate degree programs and more than 400 master's degree programs. The university is organised into colleges and schools, and has four campuses in metropolitan Phoenix (Tempe, Downtown Phoenix, Polytechnic, West Valley), with locations in Los Angeles, Washington, D.C., Hawaii and London.

Its areas of study include agriculture and life sciences, architecture, art, planning, arts and sciences, business, and computing and information science. The university has 20 colleges and schools, including four contract colleges operated under contract with New York state. dublin-city-university.brief: Dublin City University is a university on the Northside of Dublin, Ireland. Its faculties include the DCU Business School, DCU Institute of Education, Faculty of Engineering & Computing, Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences, and Faculty of Science & Health. The university is organised across three north Dublin campuses, including Glasnevin and St Patrick's.

emory-university.name: Emory University
emory-university.brief: Emory University is a private research university in Atlanta, Georgia, United States. It was founded in 1836 as Emory College by the Methodist Episcopal Church. Its main areas of study include 140+ undergraduate majors and minors and 350+ graduate and professional school programs in theology, law, medicine, nursing, business, and public health. georgetown-university.name: Georgetown University
georgetown-university.brief: Georgetown University is a private Jesuit research university in Washington, D.C., United States. It was founded by Bishop John Carroll in 1789. Its areas of study include degree and certificate programs across its 11 schools. The university has a Hilltop Campus and a Capitol Campus. Its schools include the School of Foreign Service and the College of Arts and Sciences.

heriot-watt-university.name: Heriot-Watt University
heriot-watt-university.brief: Heriot-Watt University is a public research university based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It was established in 1821 as the School of Arts of Edinburgh, the world's first mechanics' institute, and was granted university status by royal charter in 1966. Its main areas include research and postgraduate, undergraduate and graduate apprenticeship study, plus Foundation programmes. It is organised across campuses in Edinburgh, Scottish Borders, Orkney, Dubai and Malaysia, and includes Edinburgh Business School.

iowa-state-university.name: Iowa State University
iowa-state-university.brief: Iowa State University is a public land-grant research university in Ames, Iowa, United States. It was founded in 1858 as the Iowa Agricultural College and Model Farm. It offers more than 100 majors, minors and certificates. Its programs are organised by college: Agriculture and Life Sciences, Business, Design, Engineering, Health and Human Sciences, Liberal Arts and Sciences, and Veterinary Medicine. The Iowa State University Research Park and the U.S. Department of Energy's Ames Laboratory are on or near its campus.

karlsruhe-institute-of-technology.name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology
karlsruhe-institute-of-technology.brief: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology is a German public research university in Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, and a research center of the Helmholtz Association. Its main areas include Elementary and Astroparticle Physics, Energy, Health, Information, Climate and Environment, Materials, Mathematics, Humans and Technology, and Mobility.

leiden-university.name: Leiden University
leiden-university.brief: Leiden University is a public research university in Leiden, Netherlands. It was established in 1575 by William, Prince of Orange as a Protestant institution, and is the oldest surviving university in the Netherlands. Its main areas of study include Archaeology, Governance and Global Affairs, Humanities, Law, Medicine/LUMC, Science, and Social and Behavioural Sciences. Its faculties are listed as Archaeology, Governance and Global Affairs, Humanities, Law, Medicine/LUMC, Science, and Social and Behavioural Sciences. The university also has a campus in The Hague.

lund-university.name: Lund University
lund-university.brief: Lund University is a public research university in Sweden, located in the city of Lund in the Swedish province of Scania. It also has a campus in Helsingborg, Campus Helsingborg, with its own study programmes and research centres. Lund University is one of Northern Europe's oldest universities.

mcmaster-university.name: McMaster University
mcmaster-university.brief: McMaster University is a public research university in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. The main McMaster campus covers 152.4 hectares of land near the residential neighbourhoods of Ainslie Wood and Westdale, adjacent to the Royal Botanical Gardens. Its faculties are DeGroote School of Business, Engineering, Health Sciences, Humanities, Science and Social Sciences. Graduate Studies is also listed as an academic area.

psl-university.name: PSL Research University
psl-university.brief: PSL University is a public research university and grand établissement based in Paris, France. It was established in 2010 and formally created as a university in 2019. Its main areas of study include astrophysics, arts, chemistry, law, economics, finance, computer science, engineering, management, mathematics, physics, life sciences, and social sciences. It is made up of 13 institutions, including the École normale supérieure, Mines Paris, Dauphine and the Observatoire de Paris.

radboud-university-nijmegen.name: Radboud University
radboud-university-nijmegen.brief: Radboud University is a public research university located in Nijmegen, Netherlands. It offers Bachelor's, Master's and Pre-Master's programmes, with English-taught Bachelor's programmes. Research and education cover areas such as ethics and political philosophy, history and environmental sociology. The university has seven faculties.

kth-royal-institute-of-technology.name: Royal Institute of Technology
kth-royal-institute-of-technology.brief: KTH Royal Institute of Technology is a public research university in Stockholm, Sweden. It conducts research and education in engineering and technology. KTH offers over 60 master's programmes given in English, plus bachelor's, doctoral and exchange studies. The university has five schools, including the School of Engineering Sciences, the School of Architecture and the Built Environment and the School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. Its campuses include the main campus in Stockholm, and campuses in Kista, Flemingsberg, Solna and Södertälje are mentioned.

sorbonne-university.name: Sorbonne University
sorbonne-university.brief: Sorbonne University is a public research university in Paris, France. It works across Arts and Humanities, Health Sciences, and Science and Engineering. Its main academic areas include arts and humanities, health sciences, and science and engineering. The university has campuses including the Cordeliers campus in Paris. Its faculties are the Faculty of Arts and Humanities, the Faculty of Health Sciences, and the Faculty of Science and Engineering.

swinburne-university-of-technology.name: Swinburne University of Technology
swinburne-university-of-technology.brief: Swinburne University of Technology is a public research university in Melbourne, Australia. It was established as the Eastern Suburbs Technical College in 1908 and renamed Swinburne Technical College in 1913. Its study areas include Aviation, Built Environment and Architecture, Business, Design, Education, Engineering, Film and Television, Health, Information Technology, Law, Nursing, Psychology and Science.

technische-universitat-dresden.name: Technische Universität Dresden
technische-universitat-dresden.brief: Technische Universität Dresden (TU Dresden) is a public research university in Dresden, Germany. It is one of Germany's Universities of Excellence, a title it has held since 2012. Its areas of study include Natural Sciences and Mathematics, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Engineering Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, Medicine, and Teacher Training. Campuses are located in Dresden, Zittau, Tharandt, Pirna and Görlitz, among other sites. The university is organised into faculties, including a medical faculty in Dresden.

universiti-teknologi-malaysia.name: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM)
universiti-teknologi-malaysia.brief: Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) is a Malaysian public research university. It has campuses in Kuala Lumpur and Pagoh, Malaysia. The university has faculties and a senate, and its administration includes deans. Its pages list undergraduate, master's and PhD students, along with academic and management staff. UTM also has an alumni network with members in 102 countries.

university-of-aberdeen.name: University of Aberdeen
university-of-aberdeen.brief: The University of Aberdeen is a public research university in Aberdeen, Scotland. It was founded in 1495 and is Scotland's third oldest university. Its main areas of study include Arts & Humanities, Business, Social Sciences, Law, Engineering, Geosciences, Life Sciences, Physical Sciences and Medicine. Teaching and research are organised across four faculties: Arts and Humanities; Business, Law and Social Sciences; Medicine, Health and Life Sciences; and Science and Engineering. The main campuses are Old Aberdeen and Foresterhill in Aberdeen, with international campuses in Doha, Qatar and Mumbai, India.

universitat-bayreuth.name: University of Bayreuth
universitat-bayreuth.brief: The University of Bayreuth is a public research university located in Bayreuth, Germany. It is one of the youngest German universities. The main campus is on the south end of town, about 900 metres from the motorway interchange "A9". A seventh faculty is located in Kulmbach, in the centre of town. Several off-campus institutes, office buildings and the Alexander von Humboldt House are located near the campus. Study and research are organised across faculties, with buildings grouped on campus and in nearby sites.

university-of-calgary.name: University of Calgary
university-of-calgary.brief: The University of Calgary is a public research university in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It was founded in 1966 with origins in the early 1900s. Its main areas of study include medicine, arts, science, engineering, business, law, nursing, kinesiology, social work, veterinary medicine, and education. It has 14 faculties and 4 campuses: Main Campus, Downtown Campus, Foothills and Spy Hill. The university offers 250+ programs.

university-of-california-san-diego.name: University of California, San Diego
university-of-california-san-diego.brief: University of California, San Diego is a public land-grant research university in the La Jolla neighborhood of San Diego, California, United States. It was established in 1960 and is the southernmost of the ten campuses of the University of California. Its areas of study include the sciences, arts, humanities, and medicine and pharmacy. The university is organised into eight undergraduate colleges, and undergraduates are assigned to one of them while free to pursue any major.

university-of-chicago.name: University of Chicago
university-of-chicago.brief: The University of Chicago is a private research university in the Hyde Park community area of Chicago, Illinois, United States. It has been in existence since 1890. Its main campus is on Chicago's South Side, with seven international campuses and centers throughout the world. The undergraduate College offers 53 majors and 47 minors, with four divisions and seven professional schools for graduate study. Its schools and divisions include the College, the Biological Sciences Division, the Chicago Booth School of Business, and the Law School.

university-of-exeter.name: University of Exeter
university-of-exeter.brief: University of Exeter is a public research university in the West Country of England, with its main campus in Exeter, Devon. Its predecessor institutions were established in 1838, 1855, 1863 and 1888. Its main areas of study include Business, Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences, Health and Life Sciences, Environment, Science and Economy, and Medicine. It has three campuses: two in Exeter, Devon and one in Penryn, Cornwall. Its departments are organised into faculties.

university-of-groningen.name: University of Groningen
university-of-groningen.brief: The University of Groningen is a public university in the city of Groningen, Netherlands. It was founded in 1614. It offers Bachelor's and Master's degree programmes, many taught in English, plus PhD programmes. Research areas include energy, health, sustainability and ICT. The university has 11 faculties, one of which is in Leeuwarden, and its Campus Fryslân is the regional hub in Leeuwarden.

the-university-of-manchester.name: University of Manchester
the-university-of-manchester.brief: The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, with its main campus on Oxford Road. It is a red brick university, a product of the civic university movement of the late 19th century. Its main areas of study include biology, medicine and health, humanities, and science and engineering. The university has three Faculties located within one campus: Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health, Faculty of Humanities, and Faculty of Science and Engineering.

It was established in 1909 by an act of the Queensland Parliament. UQ is one of the six sandstone universities. Its campuses include St Lucia, Gatton, Herston, Dutton Park and UQ Brisbane City. Its areas of study are organised into faculties, schools, institutes and centres.

university-of-southampton.name: University of Southampton
university-of-southampton.brief: The University of Southampton is a public research university in Southampton, England, and a founding member of the Russell Group. It offers courses in areas including social statistics and demography, medicine, mathematical sciences, engineering, humanities, and art, fashion and design. The university is organised as a global campus university, with six Southampton campuses, Winchester School of Art, and international locations in Iskandar Puteri, Malaysia and Delhi, India.

universitat-stuttgart.name: University of Stuttgart
universitat-stuttgart.brief: The University of Stuttgart is a public research university located in Stuttgart, Germany. It was founded in 1829. Its study areas include architecture and urban planning, and it offers Bachelor's and Master's programs. The university consists of ten faculties, and each faculty has a group of institutes.

university-of-texas-at-austin.name: University of Texas at Austin
university-of-texas-at-austin.brief: The University of Texas at Austin is a public research university in Austin, Texas, United States. It is the flagship institution of the University of Texas System. Founded in 1883, it offers undergraduate, graduate, law, medical and nursing degree programs across its colleges and schools. Its main campus is known as the Forty Acres, and it has 16 colleges and schools, including the Cockrell School of Engineering, the McCombs School of Business and the College of Liberal Arts.

the-university-of-warwick.name: University of Warwick
the-university-of-warwick.brief: The University of Warwick is a public research university on the outskirts of Coventry, England. Founded in 1965, it is the youngest member of the Russell Group. Its research and teaching span arts, science, engineering, medicine and social sciences. The university has three faculties: Faculty of Arts, Faculty of Science, Engineering and Medicine, and Faculty of Social Sciences. It also runs a campus in Coventry and offers a range of services for students and staff.

university-of-wollongong.name: University of Wollongong
university-of-wollongong.brief: The University of Wollongong (UOW) is a public research university in Keiraville, within the coastal city of Wollongong, New South Wales, about 80 kilometres south of Sydney. Its main study areas include Accounting, Finance & Economics, Business, Engineering, Health, Law, Medical Science, Nursing and Psychology. It is organised into faculties: Arts, Society and Business; Engineering and Information Sciences; and Science, Medicine and Health. Campuses include Wollongong, Sydney, regional New South Wales and global campuses in the United Arab Emirates, Hong Kong, Malaysia and India.

utrecht-university.name: Utrecht University
utrecht-university.brief: Utrecht University is a public research university in Utrecht, the Netherlands. It was established on 26 March 1636 and is one of the oldest universities in the Netherlands. The university offers bachelor's and master's programmes, continuing education, and research. Its faculties include Science, Veterinary Medicine, Humanities, and Medical Sciences. The university works with organisations and institutes, and its address is Heidelberglaan 8, Utrecht.

washington-state-university.name: Washington State University
washington-state-university.brief: Washington State University is a public land-grant research university in Pullman, Washington, United States. It was founded in 1890. Its main areas include more than 200 undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs, with emphasis on energy, the environment and agriculture at Tri-Cities. The university has six campuses: Pullman, Spokane, Tri-Cities, Vancouver, Everett and Global Campus. It has 11 academic colleges.
